name: Marriott Bonvoy Boundless® Credit Card

apr.notes: Variable APRs from Chase pricing terms; purchase APR varies based on creditworthiness and Prime Rate.

categories.label: Combined grocery stores, gas stations, and dining purchases

rewards.redemption_notes: Points transfer to Marriott Bonvoy after each billing cycle; points do not expire as long as you make purchases on your credit card every 24 months.

signup_bonus.description: Earn 125,000 bonus points plus 1 Free Night Award after spending $3,000 on eligible purchases within 3 months of account opening. Each Free Night Award is valid for a one-night stay at properties with a redemption level up to 50,000 points per night.

benefits.title: Anniversary Free Night Award
benefits.description: Free Night Award each year after account anniversary, valid for a one-night hotel stay at a property with a redemption level up to 35,000 points. Certain hotels have resort fees.

benefits.title: Up to $100 in airline statement credits
benefits.description: Special Offer through 6/30/2027: Get up to $100 in statement credits after spending $500 on eligible airline purchases. Earn up to $50 in statement credits semi-annually after spending $250 on eligible purchases made directly with airlines.

benefits.title: Automatic Marriott Bonvoy Silver Elite Status
benefits.description: You will automatically receive Silver Elite Status each calendar year as a cardmember.

benefits.title: 15 Elite Night Credits
benefits.description: Receive 15 Elite Night Credits towards the next level of Marriott Bonvoy Elite Status each calendar year. Restrictions apply.

benefits.title: 1 Elite Night Credit for every $5,000 spent
benefits.description: Earn 1 Elite Night Credit towards Marriott Bonvoy Elite Status for each $5,000 in eligible purchases.

benefits.title: Path to Gold Elite Status
benefits.description: Earn Marriott Bonvoy Gold Elite Status after spending $35,000 on purchases in a calendar year.

benefits.title: No foreign transaction fees
benefits.description: You will pay no foreign transaction fees when you use your card for purchases made outside the United States.

benefits.title: Baggage Delay Insurance
benefits.description: Reimburses you up to $100 a day for up to 5 days for essential purchases like toiletries and clothing when baggage is delayed over 6 hours.

benefits.title: Lost Luggage Reimbursement
benefits.description: Provides reimbursement up to $3,000 per covered traveler for the cost to repair or replace checked or carry-on baggage that is lost, damaged or stolen during a covered trip.

benefits.title: Trip Delay Reimbursement
benefits.description: If your common carrier travel is delayed more than 12 hours or requires an overnight stay, you are covered for unreimbursed expenses, such as meals and lodging, up to $500 per covered traveler.

benefits.title: Purchase Protection
benefits.description: Covers your eligible new purchases for 120 days from the date of purchase against damage or theft up to $500 per item.

benefits.title: DoorDash DashPass
benefits.description: Get one-year complimentary DashPass for both DoorDash and Caviar, providing unlimited deliveries with $0 delivery fees and lower service fees on eligible orders. Activate by Dec 31, 2027.

travel_perks.hotel_status: Automatic Marriott Bonvoy Silver Elite Status; path to Gold Elite Status after $35,000 in purchases each calendar year.
other: Annual Free Night Award up to 35,000 points
15 Elite Night Credits each calendar year
Up to 17x total points at participating Marriott Bonvoy hotels when including Marriott Bonvoy member and Silver Elite earnings
Up to $100 in airline statement credits (special offer through 6/30/2027)

notes: Offers, APRs, and benefit terms can change; verified against Chase pages on last_verified date. New cardmember Free Night Award is valid up to 50,000 points; anniversary Free Night Award is valid up to 35,000 points.
